fields.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
fields.note: D040 supports the just-cause prohibition, the at-fault and no-fault cause lists, nonpayment above FMR from March 27, 2023, 3-business-day LAHD filing, annual registration, and the posted notices. It does not support the Declaration of Intent to Evict, the Chart A same-as-RSO amounts, the 15-day payment or escrow rule, the single-family one-month's-rent rule, or the rent offset. Those come from D043.

fields.quoted_span: The JCO covers most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles that are not regulated by the City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
fields.note: D040 supports the RSO exclusion, the 6-month or lease-expiry condition, the listed exemptions, and coverage of buildings newer than October 1, 1978 and single-family-only properties.
D040 cites no Los Angeles Municipal Code section, so § 165.03 cannot be verified from this document.
